name: repeaty
description: Desktop flashcards and spaced repetition, with your learning library in one folder.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config config/vite.config.ts && node scripts/check-static-build.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config config/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:server: npm run typecheck && vite build --config config/vite.config.ts --mode server
scripts.test:e2e:server: npm run build && npm run build:server && playwright test --config config/playwright.server.config.ts
scripts.check:server: node scripts/export-workspace-schema.mjs --check && vitest run --config config/vite.config.ts --mode server src/plugins/plugins.test.ts && cargo fmt --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --locked && npm run test:e2e:server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run typecheck && vite build --config config/vite.config.ts --mode desktop
scripts.test:e2e:desktop: npm run build:desktop && cargo build --locked --manifest-path crates/workspace-store/Cargo.toml --example workspace-runtime && playwright test --config config/playwright.desktop.config.ts
